about: jsonparse's mutants (wf10 corpus wave 1, PA1): each law's mutant, killed by `ergo test` of its package, and the edits no law or case sees, which TestJSONParseAgreesWithControl in cmd/ergo (JSONTestSuite, generated documents and the workload against a reference on encoding/json and the hand Go control) kills.

mutants.name: jsonparse-pointer-escapes-slash-first
mutants.rule: A pointer escapes ~ before /, so a key with a / is written ~1, not ~01 (law json.PointersReachTheirPlaces).

mutants.name: jsonparse-pointer-tilde-one-is-tilde
mutants.rule: In a pointer's token, ~1 stands for / (law json.PointersReachTheirPlaces).

mutants.name: jsonparse-quote-keeps-backslash
mutants.rule: The printers escape a backslash, so the text reads back as the value (law json.PrintParsesBack).

mutants.name: jsonparse-escape-b-is-form-feed
mutants.rule: The escape \b is the byte 0x08 (law json.PrintParsesBack: the printer writes 0x08 as \b).

mutants.name: jsonparse-zero-takes-digits
mutants.rule: No digit follows a leading 0 (law json.Numeral.ZeroEndsItsInteger).

mutants.name: jsonparse-exponent-takes-no-sign
mutants.rule: An exponent may have a sign before its digits (law json.Numeral.ExponentTakesASign).

mutants.name: jsonparse-depth-limit-one-short
mutants.rule: Arrays and objects nest 10000 deep, as in encoding/json, and the 10001st fails at its bracket.

mutants.name: jsonparse-return-is-no-space
mutants.rule: A carriage return is whitespace between tokens (RFC 8259, section 2).

mutants.name: jsonparse-invalid-utf8-kept
mutants.rule: A byte of a string that is not UTF-8 reads as U+FFFD, as in encoding/json, so every printed text is UTF-8.

mutants.name: jsonparse-newline-in-a-string
mutants.rule: A string holds no control byte unescaped: a raw newline in a string is not JSON.

mutants.name: jsonparse-unknown-escape-at-backslash
mutants.rule: A failure names the first byte that is not JSON: after a backslash, the byte that is no escape.

mutants.name: jsonparse-index-one-past-the-end
mutants.rule: A pointer's index names an element only below the array's length.
